headline: BOE Sets Official Mortgage Rate at 3.134%: The Figure That Determines How Much Thousands of Referenced Contracts Pay
summary: The Bank of Spain published in the Official State Gazette on 18 September an average mortgage loan rate of 3.134%. The figure determines payments on thousands of referenced contracts.
why: Many Spanish mortgages are priced off published reference rates, so the published figure directly sets borrowers' monthly payments.
